summary: A log host publishes only a head that continues the published one (a fast-forward, leased on the head it fetched). A second publisher whose chain is older refuses loudly and overwrites nothing.

replay.detail: No record, signature or verifier rule changes.

schema.detail: The log's commits and tree are unchanged. A refused publish adds publish_refused to the pull's JSON summary.

rules.detail: Publishing was a forced push and is now a fast-forward with a lease: a pull or gc whose head does not continue the remote's head exits 1 and publishes nothing.

compatibility.detail: hetz2's chain continues the published head, so its publishes are unchanged. Its wrapper reads scripts/evidence-log from origin/main on every pull, so it gets the guard with no install.

manual.detail: None. A host refused by the guard recovers by seeding its copy from origin's refs/evidence-log/main (docs/st3/gate-evidence.md).
